rationale: The base station auto-updated to HB-200 firmware 4.5, which removed support for the legacy v2 radio protocol. The garage motion sensor (SEN-M1) is still on firmware 1.1 speaking v2, so it connects but produces no events (E-305). An OTA path to 1.4 exists but has failed twice with an image checksum mismatch, which per the fault-code reference requires escalation to FAE as a protocol conflict.

output.symptom_summary: Garage motion sensor (SEN-M1) stopped triggering events after base station auto-updated to HB-200 firmware 4.5. Sensor remains connected and its light blinks, but no events are generated (E-305).
output.suspected_root_cause: Protocol conflict: base station now only supports v3, while sensor still runs v2 firmware (1.1), and OTA to v3-compatible 1.4 fails with checksum mismatch.
key_abnormal_indicators: OTA to 1.4 failed twice at 61% with image checksum mismatch
output.customer_reply: We've identified a firmware compatibility issue between your base station and garage sensor. Our engineering team will investigate and provide a fix. We'll follow up with you shortly. Thank you for your patience.

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

Base station firmware updates are pushed automatically at night. HB-200 firmware 4.5 removes support for the legacy v2 radio protocol. Peripherals still running v2 firmware must be upgraded to v3 firmware before or after the base station update, otherwise they disconnect.

results.text: After HB-200 auto-updated to 4.5, a CAM-I2 running 1.2 disconnected with E-305. OTA not offered for this hardware revision. Escalated; FAE confirmed protocol v2 dropped and arranged a compatibility firmware. Escalated correctly.

complaint: Since the automatic update the night before last, my garage motion sensor doesn't trigger anything. Its light still blinks when I walk past and the app shows a little update badge on it, so I suppose it just needs an update? Please tell me the quickest way to get it working again.
